about: Minting an account id (spec flow-cli-core 1.1a). Call mint(label, path, taken). Slugify = lowercase, every run of characters outside [a-z0-9] becomes one '-', trim '-' from both ends. Base = slug(label), else slug(last segment of path, / or \ separated, trailing separators ignored), else 'account'. If the base is in taken, append -2, -3, ... until free. Compare expected.id exactly. The id 'default' is reserved for a runtime's implicit account: a base of 'default' counts as taken, so it becomes 'default-2' (then -3, ...).

cases.name: no label falls back to the path's last segment
an empty label falls back to the path
a label that slugifies to nothing falls back to the path
a Windows path splits on backslashes
runs of separators collapse to one hyphen
letters outside a-z are separators, not transliterated
a label that slugifies to default is reserved: it becomes default-2
a folder named default is reserved too
